
```{r}

cor(bat_vars, use = "complete.obs")
```

## Testing different models. All will include tot_WAR, Years, ASG. (Potential to not include ASG in future)
### Pitching: ERA, SO, W, L
### 6 Models:
### - BASE
### - ERA
### - ERA, SO
### - ERA, W
### - ERA, L
### - L

### Batting: HR, SB, BA, OBP, SLG, OPS, RBI, BB, H
### 12 Models:
### - BASE
### - HR
### - HR, SB
### - BA
### - OBP
### - SLG
### - OPS
### - BA, HR
### - RBI
### - RBI, SB
### - BB
### - H

```{r}

retired_bat_d <- retired_d %>% filter(primary_pos %in% c("C", "1B", "2B", "3B", "SS", "OF"))
retired_pit_d <- retired_d %>% filter(primary_pos %in% c("P"))

```

```{r}

base_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

era_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + ERA_x,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

era_so_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + ERA_x + pit_SO,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

era_W_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + ERA_x + pit_W,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

era_L_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + ERA_x + pit_L,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

L_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + pit_L,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

```


```{r}

AIC(base_pit, era_pit, era_so_pit, era_W_pit, era_L_pit, L_pit)

```




```{r}

base_bat <- glm(

)

HR_bat <- glm(
```


### FULL RETIRED DATASET

```{r}

base_model <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years,
  data = retired_d, family = binomial
)

stargazer(base_model, type = "text")

```


```{r}

random_int <- glmer(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + (1|primary_pos),
  data = retired_d, family = binomial  
)

random_slope <- glmer(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + (tot_WAR|primary_pos),
  data = retired_d, family = binomial
)

AIC(random_int, random_slope)
ranef(random_slope)

```


```{r}

war_C <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["C", "tot_WAR"]

war_1B <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["1B", "tot_WAR"]

war_2B <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["2B", "tot_WAR"]

war_3B <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["3B", "tot_WAR"]

war_SS <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["SS", "tot_WAR"]

war_OF <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["OF", "tot_WAR"]

war_P <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["P", "tot_WAR"]

```

```{r}

tot_effects <- data.frame(
  Position = c("C", "1B", "2B", "3B", "SS", "OF", "P"),
  LogOdds = c(war_C, war_1B, war_2B, war_3B, war_SS, war_OF, war_P),
  OddsRation = c(exp(war_C), exp(war_1B), exp(war_2B), exp(war_3B), exp(war_SS), exp(war_OF), exp(war_P))
)

tot_effects

```

```{r}

re <- ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos

re_df <- data.frame(
  pos = rownames(re),
  slope = re[, "tot_WAR"]
)

ggplot(re_df, aes(x = reorder(pos, slope), y = slope)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Random WAR Effect by Position",
    x = "Position",
    y = "WAR Slope Adjustment"
  )

```
